title.narrative: CHAVITA project ’Reducing barrier preventing inclusion of the Deaf Population In Tanzania 2022-2023
CHAVITA project ’Reducing barrier preventing inclusion of the Deaf Population In Tanzania 2022-2023

description.narrative: In Tanzania, policies and legislation ensuring the rights of the Deaf are in place since many years but not adequately implemented. Society in general and duty bearers/local authorities in particular are ignorant about the policies and legislation and are lacking practical knowledge and skills in providing the required services to the Deaf Development goal: Enhanced capacity of CHAVITA, and their members to promote Deaf rights, needs that better reflect citizens’ rights, especially those of marginalized groups (Persons with disabilities, and ethnic minority and women) Direct outcome: The articles protecting rights and wellbeing of Deaf persons including right to communication using the Tanzania Sign Language (LAT) as reflected in the Persons with Disabilities Act (2010) and the Postal and communication Act Section 38(1) (a) implemented in practice to facilitate inclusion of the Deaf population in Tanzanian society. Beneficiaries: Deaf people, Other beneficiaries are Project staffs and partners, government officials at local and national level Tanzania Association of the Deaf is implementing partners. They were chosen according to the criteria announced in the call for the proposal. CHAVITA website : www.chavita.or.tz
